app.name: PostHog for Wii
app.short_description: Send your play history to PostHog
app.long_description:
Reads the play history that the Wii Menu keeps on this console and sends each play session to your PostHog project. Then it runs a small game.
Put your host and project token in apps/posthog-wii/settings.txt on the SD card.
The app writes nothing to the console's own storage.
A, B, Up or 2 jumps. HOME exits.
